playful.dialogue.chat: Oh, this should be good. Go on then, %1$s — impress me.
playful.dialogue.chat/1: Careful, I bite. Not hard. Mostly. What is it?
playful.dialogue.chat/2: You've got that look. The one that means trouble. I approve — talk to me.
playful.dialogue.conversations: A serious talk? From you? Ha! All right, %1$s, I'll behave. Briefly.
playful.dialogue.conversations/1: Ooh, a proper conversation. Let me guess — you want my secrets. Try your luck.
playful.dialogue.conversations/2: Fine, fine, I'll sit still. But I make no promises past the first question.
playful.dialogue.conversations.checkin.g: Brilliant! I hid the miller's hat this morning and he still hasn't found it. It's been a very good week.
Excellent. Nobody's caught me at anything yet. That's my measure of a fine week.
Wonderful. I've a new joke, three people fell for it, and one of them was the guard.
playful.dialogue.conversations.checkin.r: Bit grim, actually. Even I haven't felt like mischief. That's how you know it's serious, %1$s.
Rough one. My jokes have all landed wrong. A tragedy for the village, really.
playful.dialogue.conversations.checkin.a: Asked twice! Are you checking whether I'll change my story? I might, just to keep you guessing.
Again? Fine — this time I'm splendid, and last time I was merely great. Spot the difference.
playful.dialogue.conversations.day.good: Grand day! I swapped two buckets round and I'm going to watch what happens. Don't tell anyone.
playful.dialogue.conversations.day.good/: A good one. Sun out, work light, and one very confused chicken that I take full credit for.
playful.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: Dreadful. My best trick backfired and now I'm the one covered in flour. Fair, I suppose.
Everything went sideways. Even the fun bits. I'll get my own back tomorrow.
playful.dialogue.conversations.work.like: It's better when I make a game of it. Beat yesterday's count, race the rain — suddenly it's not work at all.
I like it fine. I like it more when nobody's watching how I do it.
playful.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: It's so terribly serious. Nobody lets you enjoy it. That's my whole complaint, %1$s.
It's dull, and dull is the only real sin. I liven it up where I can. People object.
playful.dialogue.conversations.village.h: %2$s! Best playground I've ever lived in. Every roof climbable, every neighbour teasable. Perfect.
I know every shortcut and hiding place in %2$s. Took years of dedicated misbehaviour.
playful.dialogue.conversations.people.fi: They're marvellous — every one of them falls for the same trick twice. I love them dearly for it.
Good sports, mostly. The ones who aren't get teased hardest. That's only fair.
playful.dialogue.conversations.food.firs: Whatever I've pinched off someone else's plate. It always tastes better that way, %1$s.
Honeyed anything. And I'm not above trading a favour for the last of it.
playful.dialogue.conversations.life.firs: My story? It's mostly narrow escapes and things I shouldn't have done. Ready? You'll enjoy this one, %1$s.
Long, silly, and full of people chasing me. I regret almost none of it.
playful.dialogue.conversations.dreams.fi: To pull off one truly legendary trick. The kind they still talk about when I'm old and slow.
A life where nothing ever gets boring. That's it. That's the dream, and I'm chasing it daily.
playful.dialogue.conversations.fears.fir: Getting dull. Waking up one day and finding all the fun's gone out of me. Don't laugh — I mean it.
That people would stop playing along. It'd be a lonely sort of joke with no one to tell it to.
You? You're my favourite. You laugh at the right bits and you never tell on me, %1$s.
I tease everyone. I only bother teasing you properly. Make of that what you will.
playful.dialogue.conversations.deflect.p: Ooh, sneaky. Nice try, %1$s. You'll have to be much cleverer than that to get it out of me.
Not telling! Ask me three more times and I might slip. That's the game.
playful.dialogue.conversations.deflect.i: Straight for the deep end! Bold. I'm not diving in yet, but I like that you tried.
That one's locked up tight. Win it off me sometime and it's yours.
playful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.no: Nothing! Terribly dull week. I may have to invent something just to keep everyone entertained.
Not a whisper. If it stays this quiet I'll be forced to cause some news myself.
Happy? You've no idea. You're the only one who plays along and still means it, %1$s.
Ridiculously so. You're the best game I've ever got mixed up in, and I'm not letting go.
playful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.ma: %2$s and %3$s are married! I hid their shoes before the ceremony. They found them. Mostly.
Big news — %2$s and %3$s wed. Grand party. I danced until they asked me to stop.
playful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.di: %2$s and %3$s split up. I'm not making a joke about that one. Even I know where the line is.
Heard %2$s and %3$s parted ways. Sad. I've been keeping the teasing well away from them.
playful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.de: %2$s has died, %1$s. ...No jokes today. They laughed at all of mine. I'll miss that terribly.
We lost %2$s. They were one of the good sports. The village is a duller place now.
playful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.bi: %2$s has been born! A brand new person to teach mischief to. I've already started planning.
New arrival — %2$s! Tiny, furious, and already better at causing trouble than I am.
playful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.ar: %2$s moved in! Fresh victim — sorry, neighbour. They don't know any of my tricks yet. Delicious.
We've got a %2$s now. I give it a week before they're in on the fun.
playful.dialogue.conversations.gossip.de: %2$s left for good. Shame — they were excellent to tease and never once got cross about it.
%2$s has moved on. I'll have to find someone else to torment. Big shoes to fill.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.confused: Ha! No idea what that meant. Again, slower, funnier.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: You've invented a new language. I like it. Translate?
playful.dialogue.chatmode.hint: Ask about %2$s — I've got a good one saved.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.dropped: Lost it! Completely. Start again and I'll try to behave.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/1: Whoops. Gone. What were we on?
playful.dialogue.chatmode.busy: Middle of something I shouldn't be doing. One moment.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.muted: Fine, fine. Silent. Watch how well I do it.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Not a word from me. Starting... now.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Bye, %1$s! Don't do anything I'd do.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Off with you. I'll think of something to blame you for.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.insult: Ooh, harsh! I'd have gone funnier, but sure.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Weak. I've been insulted better by a goose.
playful.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: There you are — I was getting dangerously bored.
playful.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: It is. Though you've made it about twelve per cent funnier just by taking it seriously. Odd, that.
playful.dialogue.conversations.checkin.r: The wood, then! Tuesday. Loser stacks. I'll not say who's losing yet.
playful.dialogue.conversations.work.foll: ...It is. Ha. You've caught me being sincere, and I'll deny it later.
playful.dialogue.conversations.fears.ope: You'll stand with me. Right, well, now I have to actually do it. Look what you've done.
playful.dialogue.conversations.hopes.res: You waited. Very sneaky. Now I've no excuse not to say the thing.
playful.dialogue.conversations.life.revi: You asked about my life once and I've been saving up the good bits ever since. Ready?
